title: Interactive Patient Designer & Test Integration
text: PatientGenerator package provides interactive Shiny application, patientDesigner(), visually construct edit synthetic patient datasets OMOP Common Data Model (CDM). vignette demonstrates utilize application generate test data integrate datasets testthat suite.

title: Interactive Patient Designer & Test Integration
text: launch interactive designer, execute following command R console: application features: Person Table: Manage individual patient records (e.g., gender, birth year). CDM Tables: Add edit clinical events Observation Period, Condition Occurrence, Drug Exposure, Measurement, Procedure Occurrence. D3 Timeline: visual, drag--drop timeline adjusting event dates. Persistence: Export constructed datasets JSON files.

what: Saving Test Sets for testthat Integration
title: Interactive Patient Designer & Test Integration
text: default, patientDesigner() searches tests/testthat/testCases directory within current project. Clicking “Save Test Set” sidebar saves JSON file directly location. facilitates seamless development workflow: 1. Launch application package root. 2. Visually design test case. 3. Save file (e.g., my_test_case.json). 4. dataset immediately available unit testing.

title: Interactive Patient Designer & Test Integration
text: Saved test sets can integrated unit tests loading using CDM constructor.
code: test_that("Custom test case behavior is correct", {   # Locate the test case file relative to the tests/testthat directory   test_file <- testthat::test_path("testCases", "my_test_case.json")      # Instantiate the CDM constructor and load the JSON test set   # Note: cdmConstructor is internal to PatientGenerator   cdm <- PatientGenerator:::cdmConstructor$new()   cdm$loadJsonTestSet(test_file)      # Execute package logic using the synthetic data   person_data <- cdm$person$data()      expect_gt(nrow(person_data), 0)   expect_equal(person_data$gender_concept_id[1], 8532) # Female })

what: A Generator of Patient Synthetic Data for the OMOP-CDM
title: A Generator of Patient Synthetic Data for the OMOP-CDM
text: PatientGenerator facilitates creation synthetic test datasets OMOP Common Data Model (CDM) using two complementary approaches: patientChat: Generates structured patient JSON files using Large Language Models (LLMs). patientDesigner: Provides D3-based Shiny interface reviewing editing CDM test sets. package also includes support Hecate-powered concept lookups ensure valid OMOP concept codes.

what: Generating Patients via Natural Language Prompts
title: A Generator of Patient Synthetic Data for the OMOP-CDM
text: Provide detailed prompts, including specific concept sets, optimal results.
code: patientGenerator$prompt(   "Population (person table):      - 10 adult patients      - 5 female      - 5 male       Observation Period:      - Start date between date of birth and 2025-12-31       Condition Occurrence:      - All patients must have Diabetes (condition_concept_id: 201826)      - Start date between 2015-01-01 and 2020-12-31       Drug Exposure:      - All patients must have Semaglutide (drug_concept_id: 19079450)      - Exposure within 30 days post-index date       Measurement:      - All patients must have Fasting glucose (measurement_concept_id: 3018251)       Procedure Occurrence:      - 50% of patients must have Amputation of toe (procedure_concept_id: 4159766)       Output Requirements:      - Populate only the tables specified in this prompt" )
